notes: Localization measures where attributions land; it is not causal faithfulness.
Correct-prediction and all-prediction subsets are reported separately.
Top-k fractions are pre-registered in the config; nothing is tuned on test.
Randomization similarity should be LOW (sensitivity to parameters is healthy).
scale_note: experiment 'full': trained on the full dataset; explanations computed on the first 500 samples of the test split. Attribution and reliability metrics therefore describe that fixed subset, not the entire split.
